name: Rain Alley
css:
/* Rain Alley: a rain-soaked alley of an imaginary city lit by abstract neon shapes (original illustration, no signs or lettering). Wet-glass panels, magenta and cyan neon trim, a neon flicker over the alley while the agent works, and a cyan tube over the composer that fills as the context does. Dark only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 14px;--t3-radius-bubble: 12px;--t3-radius-card: 10px;--t3-radius-control: 8px;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(255 80 200 / 0.5);--x-title: "Avenir Next Condensed","Avenir
